episode_alignment_policy: For each episode, raw annotation interaction timestamps are linearly mapped from that episode's observed raw interaction timestamp range onto the 0-based 128-JSONL window frame range; each window receives the nearest mapped raw interaction text.

simple.input_features: frame/context metadata plus hashed prompt/options/main_task text; answer_json fields are excluded from inputs
simple.split_policy: train on train split, report val and held-out test split
